lower_bound_source.title: An Exceptionally Difficult Binary Quadratic Optimization Problem with Symmetry: a Challenge for The Largest Unsolved QAP Instance Tai256c
lower_bound_source.version: arXiv v2; submitted 2023-12-20, last revised 2024-09-30 in the arXiv version history. The v2 PDF title page says revised 2024-10-01.
lower_bound_source.evidence: The v2 PDF states that target lower bound 44,200,000 was obtained with a 1.25% gap (PDF p. 3; Table 4 on p. 18). The v2 abstract still describes the earlier 1.48% gap.

limitations: The original ANT search is not replayed; only the archived feasible permutation and exact score are reproduced.

The checked QAPLIB pages disagree on the older lower bound: the Lehigh table gives 43,849,646, while the QAPLIB mirror gives 44,095,032. The arXiv v2 paper discusses 44,095,032 as the previous bound and reports an improved 44,200,000. Searches on 2026-11-06 found no later primary result or proof of optimality; this search was not exhaustive.
The lower bound is a result reported by the cited paper; the task checker verifies feasible scores, not optimality or lower-bound certificates.
